threat_event: Attacker or careless engineer uses standing SYS-G4 access to issue commands on the DOP or reach low impact substation gateways
threat_source: External attacker with stolen Engineering Services credentials; insider error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 230 Engineering Services accounts with standing access; vendor sessions not checked for malicious communications at 43 of 74 substations
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 6.1-6.3); Voluntary benchmark (NIST CSF 2.0; SP 800-82 Rev. 3)
existing_controls: MFA at the SYS-G4 gateway; session recording
treatment_plan: Per-session approval by the DCC; remove standing access; detection on all vendor sessions (POAM-001, POAM-013)

threat_event: Undetected intruder in the DCC networks manipulates the DOP or prepares a destructive attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network sensors in the DCC or backup DCC; DOP logs not sent to the SIEM
existing_controls: TCC sensors (other ESP); weekly manual log review by OT administrators
treatment_plan: OT sensors in both DCC networks feeding the group SOC; DOP logs to the SIEM (POAM-003, POAM-008)

threat_event: Attacker moves from the corporate network to the DOP through broad firewall rules or DMZ bypasses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37 broad rules on the IT/OT firewall; two OMS interfaces bypass the OT DMZ
existing_controls: OT domain separate from SYS-G1; EDR on DMZ servers
treatment_plan: Rule-by-rule review; deny by default; route OMS interfaces through the DMZ (POAM-005)

threat_event: Vendor or engineer sessions to low impact substations go unchecked for malicious communications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 6.3 method in place at 31 of 74 substations since 2026-04-01
existing_controls: Session recording at SYS-G4; gateway access lists
treatment_plan: Deploy detection for vendor sessions at the remaining 43 substations; self-report to SERC (POAM-013)

threat_event: Unsupported operator consoles are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 DOP operator consoles run an operating system past vendor support
existing_controls: Consoles isolated in the operator segment; no internet access
treatment_plan: Replace with the ADMS vendor's supported console build (POAM-006)

threat_event: DOP cannot be restored within its RTO after a destructive attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups on the same OT network; no offline copy; full restore not tested since 2024
existing_controls: Replication to the backup DCC; nightly backups
treatment_plan: Offline immutable backups; full restore test at the backup DCC twice a year (POAM-009)

threat_event: Unauthorized or erroneous switching command de-energizes feeders while crews are working
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DMS interlocks rely on correct tagging; tagging integrity is not monitored
existing_controls: Switching order approval; DMS safety interlocks; crew radio confirmation
treatment_plan: Integrity alerts for tag changes; quarterly interlock testing

threat_event: Electric Utility BCSI held on the Engineering Services platform is accessed by people without authorization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TCC network diagrams and EACMS configurations on SYS-S1 with project-wide group access; outside the CIP-004-7 R6 program
existing_controls: Encryption; SYS-S1 logging
treatment_plan: Designate SYS-S1 BCSI folders as an approved BCSI storage location with authorized access lists; self-report (POAM-015)

threat_event: Malicious code delivered in a DOP or relay software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hash verification used for EMS patches but not for ADMS or relay firmware
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-010-4 R1 Part 1.6 for medium impact only); Voluntary benchmark (NIST CSF 2.0; SP 800-82 Rev. 3)
existing_controls: Vendor patches tested on the DOP test system
treatment_plan: Integrity verification for all OT software and firmware

threat_event: DOE-417 or E-ISAC report is late after a DOP incident because DCC staff do not recognize cyber criteria
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCC procedures lack DOE-417 criteria 3 and 11; TCC procedures are complete
existing_controls: TCC reporting procedures; NERC compliance on call
treatment_plan: DCC reporting checklist; joint TCC and DCC drill (POAM-004)

threat_event: CIP-012-2 availability and recovery parts not met for Control Center links
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan covers Part 1.1 only; Parts 1.2 and 1.3 effective 2026-07-01
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-E2 links to the RC and neighboring TOPs
existing_controls: Diverse carrier paths exist in practice
treatment_plan: Document availability and recovery methods and responsibilities; self-report (POAM-012)

threat_event: Load-forecast error leads to costly purchases or an under-prepared peak day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 model not validated independently; no drift monitoring; weather feed errors not detected
existing_controls: Analyst review of each forecast; fallback similar-day method
treatment_plan: Independent validation; drift monitoring; input checks (POAM-024)
owner: Electric Utility manager of power supply and load forecasting

threat_event: OT administrator abuses broad domain rights on the DOP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 OT domain administrator accounts; no behavior analytics
existing_controls: Personnel risk assessments; change control
treatment_plan: Reduce to tiered admin roles (POAM-010)

threat_event: Physical attack on a transmission substation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote substations; limited camera coverage at 30 sites
regulatory_driver: EOP-004-4 R2 (damage or destruction of its Facility); DOE-417
existing_controls: Fences, locks, door alarms to the security operations center
treatment_plan: Cameras and analytics at 12 priority substations
owner: Electric Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: Mass remote disconnect of meters through a compromised AMI head-end
threat_source: Attacker in the AMI vendor or with stolen admin credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rate limit on disconnect commands; admin accounts federated but vendor support accounts local
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171 (usage data is not a listed element; see P08); Voluntary benchmark (NIST CSF 2.0; SP 800-82 Rev. 3)
existing_controls: MFA for company admins; vendor SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Command rate limits and two-person approval for bulk disconnects; review vendor support accounts

threat_event: CIS vendor breach exposes customer SSNs and bank account numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSNs retained after credit decisions
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2; encryption
treatment_plan: Stop retaining SSNs after the credit decision; contract notice within 72 hours at renewal

threat_event: Customer personal information exfiltrated from the outage map or analytics copies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Analytics copies of CIS data on SYS-G3 with broad analyst access
existing_controls: Encryption; group guardrails
treatment_plan: Masked datasets for analysts

threat_event: Hurricane forces evacuation of the DCC during restoration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup DCC runs a warm standby cluster that takes 4 hours to activate
regulatory_driver: EOP-004-4 (control center evacuation applies to the TCC, not the DCC)
existing_controls: Hardened DCC building; annual storm drill
treatment_plan: Hot standby at the backup DCC

threat_event: Fuel interruption at plants that supply 30% of purchased power during a peak
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two supplying plants depend on Gas Production gas
existing_controls: Replacement power purchases
treatment_plan: Monitor through joint peak-season plans; accepted by the division president
owner: Electric Utility manager of power supply and load forecasting

threat_event: Contractor commissioning laptop introduces malware into a low impact substation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering Services laptops reviewed under its own process; the Electric Utility does not verify the review before connection
existing_controls: Engineering Services laptop hardening and antivirus
treatment_plan: Pre-connection checklist signed by the substation supervisor

threat_event: Gateway access lists at low impact substations permit more DOP traffic than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rules allow any protocol from 8 DOP front-end processors
existing_controls: Gateways restrict sources to the FEPs and EMS
treatment_plan: Limit to required protocols and ports; self-report (POAM-014)

threat_event: Field device credentials are guessed or reused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared passwords on about 3,000 reclosers and switch controls; DNP3 Secure Authentication on 40% of devices
existing_controls: Private LTE with device certificates for the network
treatment_plan: Rotate shared device passwords; extend Secure Authentication with device replacements

threat_event: Legacy radio links carry unencrypted SCADA traffic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 300 field devices still on legacy licensed radio without encryption
existing_controls: Moving to private LTE
treatment_plan: Complete the private LTE migration

threat_event: Phishing of DCC and field staff who are excluded from phishing exercises
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCC operators and crews receive annual awareness only
existing_controls: Email filtering; MFA
treatment_plan: Include DCC and field staff in phishing exercises; OT incident recognition training
owner: Electric Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: Removable media brings malware into the DOP at the backup DCC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scanning kiosk at the DCC only
existing_controls: USB ports locked on consoles
treatment_plan: Kiosk at the backup DCC

threat_event: TCC loses Real-time data to the RC during a carrier failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two diverse paths exist but recovery steps are not documented with the RC
existing_controls: Diverse paths; carrier SLAs
treatment_plan: Documented under EU-011

threat_event: EMS vendor support delays recovery of the TCC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor team supports both TCC sites
existing_controls: 4-hour on-site commitment
treatment_plan: Accepted by the division president

threat_event: Inventory gaps hide unmanaged devices on the DOP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Distribution substation gateways and radios missing from the DOP inventory
existing_controls: ADMS device database
treatment_plan: Inventory from passive monitoring and field survey (POAM-007)

threat_event: Wildlife or weather damage to field network equipment delays restoration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Private LTE sites have 8-hour battery backup
existing_controls: Portable generators
treatment_plan: Accepted by the division president; generators prepositioned in storm season

threat_event: Newly energized transmission substation is not identified under CIP-002 in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No trigger from the energization checklist to the CIP-002 list
existing_controls: Substation standard includes low impact controls by design
treatment_plan: Add a CIP-002 step to the energization checklist
